item.title: Is Convex Better Than Firebase?
item.content:encoded: Convex comes with setup complexity, especially for non-React developers, but after that offers a great UX with capacity to scale. Firebase is easy to set up and manage, but gets more complex when scaling.

item.title: How Do Software Development Teams Work?
item.content:encoded: Get a sense for how software development teams work together, what various roles are and how they coordinate workloads.

item.title: A Better v-model with defineModel
item.content:encoded: Rather than three separate pieces for a two-way bound value, defineModel gives this common Vue component pattern a single line of syntax.

item.title: Building Trustworthy AI Experiences
item.content:encoded: Providing source attribution, explanations and transparency can help bolster user trust in an AI-powered application.

item.title: Ready for .NET 11: Day-Zero Support Across the Telerik Portfolio
item.content:encoded: The Progress Telerik portfolio of products is ready for .NET 11 support so you won’t miss a step.

item.title: QR Codes and Barcodes: Real-World Use Cases in Blazor
item.content:encoded: See how to use QR codes and barcodes together in a real use case of an event-ticketing Blazor application, plus checking in the ticket at the event.

item.title: Introducing Server Components in TanStack Start
item.content:encoded: This simple app shows how React Server Components work in TanStack Start, how server and client components compose together, and what this means for performance and application design.

item.content:encoded: Color Extensions, provided by the .NET MAUI Community Toolkit, give you a way to animate color changes or convert colors in certain situations. Take a look!

item.title: So the ‘AI Differentiator’ Is Taste … But What IS Taste?
item.content:encoded: If the only thing separating our work from AI slop is taste, then our new primary task as developers needs to be figuring out what that means.

item.title: What Are Memory and Context in AI Agent Observability?
item.content:encoded: An AI agent can complete every step successfully and still act on outdated information. Learn what memory and context are, why they matter for AI agents and how traces help pinpoint where information went wrong. See how memory tools help update or remove stale records before they affect another run.

item.title: Object Calisthenics: 9 Exercises That Will Elevate Your Code Quality
item.content:encoded: Object Calisthenics is a set of nine rules that challenges the way we think about and write object-oriented code. See how they can help evolve our code.

item.content:encoded: Dynamic applications can adapt workflows in real time as tasks change, reducing user navigation and repetitive input and providing agents with structured paths.

item.title: Design for Delegation with Progressive Autonomy
item.content:encoded: Progressive autonomy for agents works the same as delegating a presentation to a 20-year-old new hire. But full autonomy on day one is maybe not a great idea.
